repos.description: :books: 技术面试必备基础知识、Leetcode、计算机操作系统、计算机网络、系统设计
repos.summary_zh: CS-Notes 是面向技术面试的综合性学习资源，涵盖算法、操作系统、计算机网络、数据库、Java 核心技术及系统设计等计算机基础核心领域。内容结构清晰，包含剑指 Offer 和 Leetcode 题解，适合系统复习与刷题备考。
repos.summary_en: CS-Notes is a comprehensive study resource for technical interviews, covering core computer science topics including algorithms, operating systems, computer networks, databases, Java fundamentals, and system design. It features structured content with solutions to 'Jianzhi Offer' and Leetcode problems, ideal for systematic review and coding practice.

repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.summary_zh: Claude-Mem 是专为 Claude Code 设计的持久化记忆压缩系统，通过 AI 自动捕获、压缩编码开发会话中的关键信息，并在后续会话中智能注入相关上下文，显著提升 AI 编程助手的工作记忆效率与连续性。
repos.summary_en: Claude-Mem is a persistent memory compression system for Claude Code that automatically captures, compresses, and injects relevant context from coding sessions using AI, enhancing Claude's working memory and session continuity.

repos.description: Agent skills for Obsidian. Teach your agent to use Obsidian CLI and open formats including Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供专为 Obsidian 设计的 Agent 技能集，支持 Markdown、Bases、JSON Canvas 和 CLI 操作，兼容 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent 框架，实现知识管理与自动化处理的无缝集成。
repos.summary_en: This repo delivers agent skills for Obsidian, enabling creation and editing of Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas files, and CLI interactions. Fully compatible with Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode via the Agent Skills specification.

repos.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
repos.summary_zh: WeKnora 是腾讯开源的 LLM 驱动文档理解与检索框架，基于 RAG 范式实现深度语义检索与上下文感知回答。支持多模态预处理、向量索引、智能检索及自定义 Agent，提供知识库管理、API 认证、K8s 部署等能力，适用于复杂异构文档的智能问答场景。
repos.summary_en: WeKnora is an LLM-powered framework for deep document understanding and semantic retrieval using the RAG paradigm. It features modular architecture with multimodal preprocessing, vector indexing, intelligent retrieval, and custom agents. Supports knowledge base management, API authentication, K8s deployment, and advanced features like thinking mode and data analysis.

repos.description: This repository is outdated and new Boost Note app is available! We've launched a new Boost Note app which supports real-time collaborative writing. https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote-App
repos.summary_zh: BoostNote-Legacy 是一款面向程序员的开源笔记应用，支持多平台（Mac、Windows、Linux）。该仓库已标记为过时，推荐使用支持实时协作的新版 BoostNote 应用，其基于 Electron、React + Redux 构建，提供跨平台桌面与移动端支持。
repos.summary_en: BoostNote-Legacy is an open-source note-taking app designed for programmers, supporting Mac, Windows, and Linux. This repository is deprecated; users are advised to migrate to the new BoostNote app, which features real-time collaborative writing and is built with Electron, React + Redux.

repos.description: An Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code/Codex as an AI collaborator in your vault
repos.summary_zh: Claudian 是一款 Obsidian 插件，将 Claude Code 嵌入为 AI 协作者，赋予知识库完整的代理能力：文件读写、搜索、Bash 命令执行和多步工作流。支持上下文感知、图像分析、内联编辑、自定义指令、技能扩展、MCP 集成及高级模型控制，适用于桌面端知识管理与自动化任务处理。
repos.summary_en: Claudian is an Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code as an AI collaborator, enabling full agentic capabilities within your vault: file read/write, search, bash commands, and multi-step workflows. It supports context-awareness, vision via drag-and-drop, inline editing, custom instructions, slash commands, MCP integration, and advanced model control for enhanced knowledge management and automation.

repos.description: Personal memory across agents
repos.summary_zh: memU 是一个专为 24/7 主动式 AI 代理设计的内存框架，将内存建模为文件系统，支持层级分类、跨引用和持久化存储。它通过结构化记忆减少 LLM 令牌成本，实现持续理解用户意图并主动执行任务，适用于 openclaw、moltbot 等长期运行代理。
repos.summary_en: memU is a memory framework for 24/7 proactive AI agents, modeling memory as a file system with hierarchical categories, cross-references, and persistent storage. It reduces LLM token costs by caching insights and enables continuous understanding of user intent, making always-on agents practical for production systems like openclaw and moltbot.

repos.description: A simple, Git-powered wiki with a local frontend and support for many kinds of markup and content.
repos.summary_zh: Gollum 是一个基于 Git 的轻量级 Wiki 系统，支持多种标记语言（如 Markdown、AsciiDoc 等），提供本地前端界面和版本控制功能。它允许用户通过 Git 仓库管理 Wiki 页面，支持实时编辑、历史回溯、数学公式、图表（Mermaid/PlantUML）、BibTeX 引用等高级功能，兼容 GitHub/GitLab Wiki，适合团队协作与知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Gollum is a Git-powered wiki system that enables version-controlled, human-editable text files organized in a Git repository. It supports multiple markup languages, real-time editing, page history, diagrams (Mermaid/PlantUML), math rendering, citations, and integrates seamlessly with GitHub/GitLab wikis for collaborative documentation.

repos.description: Self-evolving memory OS for LLM & AI Agents: ultra-persistent memory, hybrid-retrieval, and cross-task skill reuse, with 35.24% token savings and DeepSeek Harness support.
repos.summary_zh: MemOS 2.0（星尘）是一个专为 LLM 和智能体系统设计的 AI 记忆操作系统，支持跨任务技能记忆的持久化存储与进化。通过混合检索机制（FTS5 + 向量搜索）实现高效记忆管理，显著降低 token 消耗（节省35.24%），并在 LongMemEval、PrefEval-10 等基准测试中表现优异。提供云端与本地两种部署模式，兼容 OpenClaw 等多智能体框架，支持技能复用与协作。
repos.summary_en: MemOS 2.0 (Stardust) is an AI memory OS designed for LLM and agent systems, enabling persistent skill memory across tasks with reuse and evolution. It combines FTS5 and vector search for hybrid retrieval, reducing token usage by 35.24% while achieving top-tier performance on benchmarks like LongMemEval (+40.43%) and PrefEval-10 (+2568%). Supports cloud and local deployment modes, integrates with multi-agent frameworks like OpenClaw, and enables skill sharing and collaboration.

repos.description: Not Just A Notepad! (golang + mongodb) http://leanote.org
repos.summary_zh: Leanote 是一款功能强大的开源笔记应用，采用 Go 语言和 MongoDB 构建，提供富文本和 Markdown 编辑器，支持 Vim/Emacs 编辑模式、知识管理、协作分享及博客发布。它弥补了 Evernote 在代码高亮、实时渲染、跨平台支持等方面的不足，适合个人与团队知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Leanote is a powerful open-source note-taking app built with Go and MongoDB, featuring rich-text and Markdown editors, Vim/Emacs modes, knowledge management, collaboration, and blogging. It addresses Evernote's limitations in code syntax highlighting, real-time rendering, and cross-platform support, ideal for personal and team knowledge management.

repos.description: Practice English, one strike, one step forward
repos.summary_zh: TypeWords 是一款开源英语单词与文章练习工具，基于 Nuxt 构建。支持跟读、听写、自测、默写等多种模式，内置 CET-4/6、雅思、托福等主流词库，通过艾宾浩斯记忆曲线智能规划学习，提供双语对照与发音跟读，界面简洁无广告，数据本地存储。
repos.summary_en: TypeWords is an open-source English vocabulary and article practice tool built with Nuxt. It supports follow-along, dictation, self-test, and memory typing modes, with built-in word banks for CET-4/6, IELTS, TOEFL and more. Features spaced repetition algorithms, bilingual comparison, pronunciation playback, and a clean ad-free interface with local data storage.

repos.description: AI 视频笔记生成工具 让 AI 为你的视频做笔记
repos.summary_zh: BiliNote 是一款开源 AI 视频笔记生成工具，支持哔哩哔哩、YouTube、抖音等平台视频链接自动提取内容，结合 GPT 或通义千问等模型生成结构化 Markdown 笔记，支持插入截图、跳转链接及多版本记录，提供本地部署与在线体验。
repos.summary_en: BiliNote is an open-source AI video note generator that automatically extracts content from Bilibili, YouTube, Douyin, and other platforms to create structured Markdown notes using GPT, DeepSeek, or Qwen models. It supports screenshots, jump links, multiple versions, and local deployment with optional CUDA acceleration.

repos.description: Claude Skill: Multi-source content processor for NotebookLM. Supports WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDF, Markdown, search queries → Podcast/PPT/MindMap/Quiz etc.
repos.summary_zh: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm 是一个 Claude Code Skill，支持将微信公众号、网页、YouTube、PDF、Markdown 等 15 种以上内容源自动处理并上传至 Google NotebookLM，生成播客、PPT、思维导图、Quiz 等多种输出格式。其核心亮点是内置 6 层付费墙绕过机制，可自动提取 300+ 付费网站内容，结合 AI 实现多模态内容转换。
repos.summary_en: qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm is a Claude Code Skill that processes 15+ content sources—including WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDF, and Markdown—and uploads them to Google NotebookLM to generate outputs like podcasts, PPTs, mind maps, and quizzes. Its standout feature is a 6-layer paywall bypass system that automatically extracts content from 300+ premium news sites, enabling AI-powered multimodal content transformation.

repos.description: Visual Skills Pack for Obsidian: generate Canvas, Excalidraw, and Mermaid diagrams from text with Claude Code
repos.summary_zh: Obsidian Visual Skills Pack 是一个实验性插件，通过 Claude Code 将文本自动转换为 Excalidraw（手绘风格）、Mermaid（流程图）和 Canvas（彩色卡片布局）三种可视化图表。支持中文文本处理、动画生成及多输出模式，适用于思维导图、流程设计、系统架构等场景，显著提升知识表达效率。
repos.summary_en: The Obsidian Visual Skills Pack is an experimental plugin that uses Claude Code to automatically convert text into three types of visual diagrams: Excalidraw (hand-drawn style), Mermaid (flowcharts), and Canvas (colorful card layout). It supports Chinese text, animations, multiple output modes, and is ideal for mind maps, workflows, and system architecture visualization.

repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是冬瓜关于 Pi-Agent SDK 的深度学习笔记，系统拆解了生产级 AI Agent 运行时的核心架构。教程涵盖 Agent Loop、工具系统、事件驱动等 10 大模块，通过 TypeScript 与 Python 双语言对照，深入剖析了 Agent SDK 的设计取舍与源码实现，适合希望构建或理解 Agent 底层逻辑的开发者。
repos.summary_en: A deep-dive tutorial repository on the Pi-Agent SDK, systematically deconstructing the core architecture of production-grade AI Agent runtimes. Covering 10 modules including Agent Loop, tool systems, and event-driven design, it provides TypeScript and Python dual-language comparisons to analyze the source code and design trade-offs of Agent SDKs for developers.

repos.description: A better file browser and calendar inspired by Apple Notes, Bear, Evernote and Day One.
repos.summary_zh: Notebook Navigator 是 Obsidian 的一款插件，用简洁的双窗格界面替代默认文件浏览器，支持文件夹树、标签浏览、文件预览、键盘导航、拖拽操作、固定笔记及高度可定制化显示选项，显著提升笔记管理效率。
repos.summary_en: Notebook Navigator is an Obsidian plugin that replaces the default file explorer with a clean two-pane interface, offering folder tree navigation, tag browsing, file previews, keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop, pinned notes, and customizable display options for efficient note management.

repos.description: 一键将视频转换为优质小红书笔记，自动优化内容和配图
repos.summary_zh: 视频笔记生成器一键将视频内容转换为优质小红书笔记，支持自动语音转文字、AI内容优化、标题创作、配图获取及标签生成。V2.0版本采用FastAPI提供现代化Web界面，支持批量处理、长视频解析、智能错误重试与历史记录管理，显著提升内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: Video Note Generator automatically converts videos into high-quality Xiaohongshu notes with speech-to-text, AI content optimization, title generation, image fetching, and hashtag creation. V2.0 features a modern FastAPI web interface, batch processing, 30-minute video support, smart retry mechanisms, and history tracking for efficient content production.

repos.description: Aser is a lightweight, self-assembling AI Agent frame.
repos.summary_zh: Aser 是一个轻量级、自组装的 AI 智能体框架，支持模块化组合与快速开发。通过几行代码即可构建具备工具调用、知识库、记忆、MCP 协议等能力的智能体，适用于 Web3、自动化任务和多智能体协作场景，提供丰富的示例与扩展能力。
repos.summary_en: Aser is a lightweight, self-assembling AI agent framework enabling rapid development of modular agents. With just a few lines of code, users can build agents with tools, knowledge retrieval, memory, MCP protocol, and more, ideal for Web3 automation, multi-agent collaboration, and advanced AI workflows.

repos.description: Persistent, provider-neutral memory for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and MCP coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: PAXM 是一款专为 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code 等）设计的持久化、跨厂商记忆系统。它通过本地 SQLite 存储项目决策、架构规范与上下文，实现不同会话和不同代理间的知识无缝流转，解决每次新会话需重复解释项目背景的问题，且支持灵活切换 Zep、Mem0 等外部记忆存储提供商。
repos.summary_en: PAXM is a persistent, provider-neutral memory system designed for AI coding agents like Codex and Claude Code. It stores project decisions, conventions, and context locally via SQLite, enabling seamless knowledge transfer across different sessions and agents. It eliminates the need to re-explain project backgrounds and supports flexible switching between storage backends like Zep and Mem0.

repos.description: WeSight Obsidian plugin for local agent runtimes.
repos.summary_zh: WeSight Obsidian 插件将 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等本地 AI 代理集成至 Obsidian 笔记系统，提供侧边栏聊天、内联编辑、文件引用与斜杠命令等功能。支持互联网快照分享、飞书文档同步及微信公众号草稿发布，实现 AI 协作与多平台内容分发的无缝衔接。
repos.summary_en: WeSight Obsidian plugin integrates local AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode directly into your Obsidian vault. Features include sidebar chat, inline editing, file mentions, and slash commands. It supports internet snapshot sharing, Feishu document sync, and WeChat Official Account draft publishing, enabling seamless AI collaboration and multi-platform content distribution.

repos.description: Local-first Windows WeChat memory archive with traceable PDF, Markdown, and JSON exports｜本地优先的微信个人记忆库
repos.summary_zh: 微信 AI 记忆库是一款本地优先的桌面工具，直接从 Windows 微信 4.x 读取聊天记录，支持按会话、日期和关键词筛选，可导出 PDF、Markdown 与结构化 JSON。全程仅操作临时数据库副本，图片恢复、语音转写（faster-whisper）均在本机完成，无任何数据上传。
repos.summary_en: WeChat AI Memory is a local-first desktop tool that directly reads Windows WeChat 4.x chat data, supports filtering by conversation, date, and keywords, and exports to PDF, Markdown, and structured JSON. All operations—including image recovery and voice transcription via faster-whisper—stay on-device with zero data uploads.

repos.description: singleFile + gh pages + deepseek api + notion db + tg bot = web clipper and notify
repos.summary_zh: Web Clipper Backend 是一个网页剪藏服务，支持将网页通过 SingleFile 插件保存至 GitHub Pages，利用 DeepSeek API 自动生成摘要与标签，并同步至 Notion 数据库，同时通过 Telegram Bot 推送通知，实现全自动化内容归档与知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Web Clipper Backend is an automated web clipping service that saves web pages via SingleFile to GitHub Pages, uses DeepSeek API for AI-generated summaries and tags, syncs data to Notion database, and sends notifications via Telegram Bot, enabling seamless content archiving and knowledge management.

repos.description: 一款跨平台智能笔记 Agent 应用，支持多格式笔记、本地知识库、AI 智能助手、向量语义检索 。
repos.summary_zh: OpenNote 是一款跨平台智能笔记 Agent 应用，支持多格式笔记管理、本地知识库构建、AI 智能助手及向量语义检索。具备长期记忆与自我进化能力，通过 MCP 协议与 AI 大模型深度集成，实现知识的高效组织与智能问答，适合个人知识管理与 AI 增强型笔记场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenNote is a cross-platform intelligent note-taking Agent application that supports multi-format note management, local knowledge base building, AI-powered assistance, and vector semantic search. With long-term memory and self-evolving capabilities, it integrates deeply with AI large language models via the MCP protocol, enabling efficient knowledge organization and intelligent Q&A for personal knowledge management and AI-enhanced note-taking scenarios.
